scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma && cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: cd backend && npm install && npm run vercel-build && cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
